title: 呆眼点头
editing_notes: 由真实 B 站《对对对》《好欸好欸》附图重新画九个主要姿势。使用全片统一的头肩裁切以清楚显示下巴和呆毛。
抽帧后剪去一次提前抬头的关键姿势，让下点、底部停顿、抬回只发生一轮。

keys.prompt:
Make ONE precise production keyframe sheet of NINE sequential animation illustrations. EXACTLY 3 columns and 3 rows of 512x512 SQUARE cells, total 1536x1536; read row major. Invisible equal grid divisions, absolutely no written text, numbers, lettering, panel frames or gutters. Each cell has exactly the same fixed lens, solid opaque pure WHITE background, mild safe margins and fixed ground line. Draw the reference character(s) large, with the same recognizable face design, costume, hair and accessories across the 9 cells. Only characters requested in the story. Draw graphic chibi animation cels with clean shapes, not a close-up collage, no motion blur. Each cell must show a DIFFERENT complete acting pose. This is one story with a readable pay-off and reset, including hands, gaze and props. At small chat scale every pose reads. STORY: Single sailor-collar Xingtong, silver side part, crossed hairpins. Deadpan white round stare, anticipatory stillness, exactly one committed downward nod, tiny overshoot, her loose forelock bounces back half a beat after head. Return blank stare.
NINE chronological drawings: 1) 0.00 s: Draw full-body Xingtong facing the fixed camera, sailor collar, silver side-parted hair, crossed hairpins, resting forelock, round white staring eyes, flat mouth, and empty hands beside her hips. 2) 1.35 s: Keep her head upright and blank eyes facing the viewer; draw slightly braced shoulders, unchanged hands, and a motionless forelock for anticipatory stillness. 3) 1.65 s: Begin the single committed nod, pitching her head downward 12 degrees while the loose forelock trails upward; keep her torso, feet, and hands fixed. 4) 1.90 s: Draw her head bowed 25 degrees, chin lowered decisively, white eyes still directed toward the viewer, and the forelock beginning to swing forward. 5) 2.05 s: Add a tiny downward overshoot to 27 degrees; draw the forelock farther forward, preserving her deadpan mouth and stationary body. 6) 2.45 s: Return her head to its original upright angle without an upward overshoot; leave the loose forelock hanging forward, delayed behind the recovery. 7) 2.70 s: Keep her head completely still as the forelock bounces outward, reaching its rebound peak half a beat after the head stops; restore the blank frontal stare. 8) 3.10 s: Hold the upright blank stare; draw the forelock tip four pixels left of its resting position as its single rebound settles. 9) 4.60 s: Keep the entire figure still except the forelock tip, now one pixel left of rest, forming a distinct adjacent pose that eases into pose one at 4.80 seconds.
Continuity: Use one fixed frontal camera for the 4.80-second loop, preserving her design, unblinking viewer-directed stare, visible empty hands, planted feet, and prop-free scene through exactly one nod and a seamless forelock settle. ATTACHMENT AUTHORITY: the left subject is directly illustrated from the real Bilibili official pack Xingtong 好欸好欸 and 对对对: use her squat round silver-grey bob shape, big angular silver side-swept bang, small loop-shaped crossing slim hairpins on the viewer-right, dark plum tapered ink, broad warm red cheeks, low-set eyes with lively lash detail, dark navy sleeves and white sailor collar with powder-blue trim. Closely follow the shape and color blocks in the small original stickers. Omit their printed writing and onomatopoeia. Do not use generic idol character design. Where the reference shows no pupils for a gag, preserve that deliberate feature in the nod; ordinary open eyes of Xingtong are blue. Nailü, whenever requested, uses the taupe, green, white-flower figure at RIGHT of the guide. Do not draw the attachment collage as a new scene. Nailü has exactly ONE brown HEART-SHAPED COWLICK attached to the top of the head. Hair flowers and green bang streak match the right-side guide; absolutely NO floating green wavy symbols above her head. Her eye direction and smiles vary with the scene.

Return a continuous production sheet in EXACTLY the same layout as this reference: THREE columns, FOUR rows, TWELVE equally sized complete square images, read left-to-right top-to-bottom. Fill every square with one fully drawn camera-locked scene. Its white background, screen coordinates, character scale, clothing and props agree with the reference. No grids, numbering, words, motion trails, crossfades or double hands. The attached four rows give A, B, B, C. Create TWO successive micro-actions: top TWO rows are SIX evenly spaced DIFFERENT complete inbetween poses from the first reference A toward B, bottom TWO rows are SIX from B toward C. The six progress values in EACH block are about 10%,26%,42%,58%,74%,90%. Source extremes are supplied separately in the final GIF, so fill ALL cells with precision motion, never six identical drawings. Follow bright clean line art and maintain exact registration and hand identity; no autonomous camera shake. Full story for context: Single sailor-collar Xingtong, silver side part, crossed hairpins. Deadpan white round stare, anticipatory stillness, exactly one committed downward nod, tiny overshoot, her loose forelock bounces back half a beat after head. Return blank stare.

B = 1.35 s: Keep her head upright and blank eyes facing the viewer; draw slightly braced shoulders, unchanged hands, and a motionless forelock for anticipatory stillness.
C = 1.65 s: Begin the single committed nod, pitching her head downward 12 degrees while the loose forelock trails upward; keep her torso, feet, and hands fixed.
Trust the actual illustrated poses in the attachment for the shape, timing and exact action. Preserve figure count and source costume. Never place hands, limbs or extra flowers into adjacent cells.
